basis: Conservative determination: an outcome transfers only when its assessment requirements are unchanged and original assessed evidence for it exists. The continuation baseline has no outcome contract, its grader retained no outcome-level evidence, and existing records do not identify which historical course a learner saw. No 5.0 outcome meets that test, so all require new assessment. Original credit, XP and credentials remain earned in the original course.
